name: Visitor Visa / NZeTA

qualifying_event.description: Australian citizens travelling on an Australian passport need neither a Visitor Visa nor an NZeTA. Citizens of visa-waiver countries need only an NZeTA (an online travel authorization); everyone else must apply for a Visitor Visa in advance.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Passport; proof of funds or sponsor; return/onward travel evidence.

requirements.blocker_text: At least NZD 1,000/month in funds (NZD 400/month if accommodation is already paid for), or a sponsor covering living costs.
Must show a departure ticket, proof of funds to buy one, or a sponsor's commitment to cover exit travel.
Must be of good character; a police certificate (under 6 months old) is required if total time in NZ will exceed 24 months.

outcome.duration_length: up to 6 months (multiple-entry, per 12-month period) or up to 9 months (single-entry, per 18-month period)

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Visitor Visa: funds (NZD 1,000/month or NZD 400/month with prepaid accommodation), return-travel evidence, health/character requirements, 6-month/9-month duration options, NZeTA waiver for Australians and eligible nationalities

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). study_rights modeled 'restricted' since visitor status permits up to 3 months of study during the visit, not full enrollment rights (see nz_student_permit.json for the dedicated study route).
